correctness.rationale: FOUR truth/falsity tables reduce constant-free ∧∨¬ term functions to the nonconstant monotone Boolean truth maps on 2k coordinates with falsity 1−f∘θ. For monotone f,g, their disagreement D is order-convex and excludes 0,1; conversely indicators of ↑D and ↑D\D realize any such D, proving E=Q\(D∪θD). At k=1,2 a complete enumeration (not a sampled length bound) establishes all θ-stable endpoint-containing sets are equalizers: 4 and 512 respectively; 166 possible 2-var term maps and their 27,556 ordered pairs have the stated exact size histogram. At k=3 a six-point θ-stable set has a three-element chain with forbidden intermediate cube points; no union of two convex subsets can cover it. Adding θ-fixed coordinates extends the obstruction to every k>3. The source finite checker and independent exhaustive 166-map computation corroborate the finite classification.
